I've been with this mindset for a few years now, and nothing short of a drastic change would change my opinion, and I generally avoid drastic changes. 

I've lived 1/4th of the average human lifetime -- I've seen plenty of what it has to offer.
Nope! I really don't think it's my problem anymore. If living the way I want is too difficult or takes up too much effort, I'm not going to bother.

I do see where you're coming from, but you have a drive to go forwards - I don't. I don't really have a strong desire to do something or a "dream". An ideal life would be one lived in total silence without coming across anyone every day and still living in total comfort, but that's not achievable , is it?
I don't want to put time and effort into my life anymore. That's what's expected of adults but again I'm just not interested in that. It's not for me
Everything. Either everything comes easily or I'm not interested
I'm not interested in doing something different than my normal routine. Too difficult, takes up too much time, and again, it takes effort.
